messages:
anna: Quick heads-up  launching a Migration Dashboard in Console next week. Shows per-api-key risk, suggested migration snippets, and an estimated impact score. Preview + docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/migration-dashboard
pete: Nice. How do we compute the impact score?
anna: Combines observed shapes (telemetry), call frequency, and diff severity (AST + runtime). Scale 0-100. We surface top 10 at-risk keys per org.
harper: Telemetry/privacy question  are payloads uploaded?
anna: No raw payloads. We send hashed signature + counts and anonymized mapping usage. Org-admin can opt-out. Enterprise can request more detail under DPA.
docs: Docs work: we need a generated "one-click snippet" format per language and a small migration guide template. I'll add a docs generator that pulls the CI artifact.
maya: Badge idea: add a "migration-ready" badge to SDK READMEs when a snippet exists. Ops can toggle visibility.
pete: Languages supported at launch? JS + Python + Go. We'll add Java later.
ci-bot: Canary job scheduled: migration-dashboard-canary at 2025-07-20T08:00Z. Will include snippet generation, dashboard backend, and console banners.
anna: Example CLI to generate local report: `npx redwood-migrate report --from=1.3.0 --to=HEAD --out=./migration-report.html`
harper: For privacy we should surface how to delete telemetry for a key.
anna: Good call. We'll add a "forget this key" action in the dashboard and document retention window (30 days for anonymized counts, 7 days for temp artifacts).
docs: Rollout plan: week 1 canary + docs + email to active keys; week 2 in-console banner; week 3 general availability. I'll own the migration guide template.
maya: I'll add the README badge linter and a small recipe in SDK cookbook.
pete: QA ask: add integration tests that exercise snippet execution against a sample app.
anna: Agreed. Tag @qa and @release in PRs. Thanks all :rocket:
